description: This file defines the LeadsVarDefHandler class which extends VarDefHandler to customize field definitions for the Leads module in SuiteCRM. It overrides the get_vardef_array method to filter out legacy calls and meetings based on certain conditions.

classes.name: LeadsVarDefHandler
classes.description: A class extending VarDefHandler to customize vardef array for Leads module in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: get_vardef_array
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to filter out legacy 'oldcalls' and 'oldmeetings' entries from the vardef array based on the 'rel_filter' context.
